name: finance-tracker-bot
description: Personal finance tracker: send a message to a Telegram bot ("makan siang 35rb gofood", "gaji 15jt masuk", "nabung 2jt"), Gemini parses it, and a Google Apps Script web app writes it to a Google Sheet. Looker Studio reads the Sheet for spending, income and savings. Runs entirely on free tiers, no card, no server.

scripts.check: f="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/gas-check.js"; cat apps-script/*.gs > "$f" && node --check "$f" && echo "Syntax OK"
